ModMetaData.name: Male Wolfein Expanded
ModMetaData.author: Keullaeseu
ModMetaData.description:
Adds rare male Wolfein (10% by default).
- Male adult body + Ghoul variant, with tail and ear offsets. - Flat child bodies, so boys no longer use the breasted base child art. - Removes fixedGender on Wolfein pawns so maleGenderProbability applies. - With XML Extensions: adjust the spawn chance in Mod Settings (0-100%, restart required). Without it: fixed 10%.
Requires Wolfein Race. Load after Wolfein Race.
Supported Wolfein mods (Male apparel mirrors included where needed): - Wolfein Black Science Expand - Wolfein Race MegaCorp Edition - Wolfein extension: Little Red Riding Hood - Wolfein Allegiance, Imperial Weapons, Extra Backstories / Genes, Gene Patch, GFI Expand (no apparel, no patch needed).
